name: How long does it take to get new cabinets after ordering?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get new cabinets after ordering?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lead time for new cabinets varies significantly based on the type chosen. Stock cabinets might be available within a few days to a couple of weeks, depending on supplier inventory. Semi-custom cabinets typically have a lead time of 4-8 weeks, as they are assembled to order. Custom cabinets, being entirely built from scratch to your unique specifications, generally require the longest lead time, often 8-16 weeks or more. This duration does not include the actual installation time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lead times for new cabinets vary: stock (days-weeks), semi-custom (4-8 weeks), and custom (8-16+ weeks).
